gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Thin steel rod bent into every letter: that is Righteous, with no thick-and-thin contrast to slow the eye. And Noto Sans Balinese leaves breathing space inside every curve, the pair's real gift.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-carian: Commanding and fun, Righteous draws with the flat line of a fineliner on paper. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades, so paragraphs of it should move along cleanly.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-cham: Pipe-cleaner letters, loud and fun, make Righteous hard to ignore. Noto Sans Cham, a modern sans-serif built from tall rounded lowercase and generous entry space, can stand a size bump without losing its manner.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Righteous is monoline lettering with a loud streak. Noto Sans Duployan, a contemporary sans-serif with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, gives that monoline energy a spacious place to land.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-gujarati: Blueprint lettering with a commanding grin. Noto Sans Gujarati, a modern sans-serif, ends its curves before they turn inward and leaves large open counters, a quiet foil to the constant line of Righteous.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Righteous draws every letter like thin steel rod, with no thick-thin swing and a commanding, playful streak. Noto Sans Hanunoo, a sans-serif with open terminals, lets that heading speak first.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-hk: Fun and forceful, Righteous bends thin steel rod into curves with no stress. Noto Sans HK does the quieter work: large lowercase forms and brush ends lifted away before each curve closes.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Compass-pencil consistency with a loud, playful streak: that is Righteous. Noto Sans Kaithi has lowercase that stands almost like capitals and an e with an open channel, which keeps the loud heading company without competing.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-kayah-li: Clean lines, loud attitude: Righteous keeps its joins as sturdy as its stems. Shrink Righteous and its swagger fades, while Noto Sans Kayah Li, with capitals barely taller than its lowercase, holds its own.
gen-righteous-gf-noto-sans-khojki: Rope-like and loud, Righteous makes every stem, bowl and tail feel cut from one cord. Noto Sans Khojki then steps in with exits wide enough to pass light and a large, clear eye on every e.
